faq.description: Answers to common questions about the 3.5 Rover V8 in the Land Rover Discovery 1. If yours is not covered, our team can help.

faqs.q: How do you confirm a 3.5 V8 engine fits my Discovery 1?
faqs.a: We check the engine number, VIN and registration, then compare the sump, mounts, ancillaries and fuel system with the replacement. Rover V8 engines from other vehicles can differ, so compatibility is confirmed before supply.

faqs.q: How do used, reconditioned and rebuilt Rover V8 engines compare?
faqs.a: A used engine comes from a donor vehicle, a reconditioned engine is stripped and given new wear parts, and a rebuild restores your original V8. We recommend an option after assessing the fault and vehicle.

faqs.q: Can I buy a Rover V8 3.5 engine supply only?
faqs.a: Yes. Trade buyers, independent garages, restorers and private customers can buy supply only. Alternatively, choose supply and fit and our technicians will install the engine at our Grays, Essex workshop.

faqs.q: What affects the cost of a Discovery 1 3.5 V8 engine replacement?
faqs.a: The cost depends on the engine option, the condition of your current engine, any ancillary parts needed for the fuel or cooling system, and whether fitting is included. Send your registration or VIN for a written quote.

faqs.q: Do replacement 3.5 V8 engines come with a warranty?
faqs.a: Warranty cover depends on the engine option and whether we carry out the installation. We confirm the exact terms in writing with your quote, so you know what is covered before work begins.

faqs.q: Do you deliver Rover V8 engines across the UK?
faqs.a: Yes. We deliver engines throughout the United Kingdom from our Grays workshop. Delivery arrangements and costs are confirmed in your quote, and supply and fit customers can bring their Discovery to us.

faqs.q: How long does a 3.5 V8 engine replacement usually take?
faqs.a: The timescale depends on engine availability, whether a rebuild is needed and any additional work found during inspection. We give you an estimated timeframe with your quote and keep you informed throughout.

workshopIntro.title: Repair, Rebuild or Replace Your Rover V8?
workshopIntro.description: The fault, the engine's condition and how original you want the Discovery to remain all guide the decision. Ignition, fuelling, timing chain and oil leak faults can often be repaired individually. If the engine has overheated badly or shows heavy internal wear, a rebuild or Land Rover Discovery 1 3.5 V8 engine replacement is usually more practical.
paragraphs: Classic aluminium V8s depend on a healthy cooling system and correct maintenance. Where relevant, we inspect the radiator, water pump, viscous fan, hoses and thermostat, check the ignition and fuelling components, and renew the oil, filters and coolant before the engine runs.

Send your registration or VIN with a short description of the symptoms. We will confirm compatibility, explain your options and quote for supply only, supply and fit at our Grays workshop, or delivery anywhere in the UK.

engineProblems.title: Common 3.5 Rover V8 Problems
engineProblems.description: The Rover V8 is an older design, so early symptoms deserve attention before wear causes wider damage.

cards.title: Timing Chain Stretch
cards.description: A rattle from the front cover, poor running or retarded ignition timing can indicate a stretched timing chain or worn gears. We check chain slack and valve timing.

cards.title: Camshaft and Follower Wear
cards.description: A persistent ticking or tapping, loss of power or rough running may come from worn camshaft lobes, followers or hydraulic tappets. We inspect the valve train and camshaft.

cards.title: Head Gasket and Overheating
cards.description: Coolant loss, white smoke, overheating or oil contamination can indicate head gasket failure, often linked to cooling system faults on older engines. We pressure-test the cooling system and heads.
cards.action: Fuel rail and injector leak-off test

cards.title: Rear Main Seal Oil Leaks
cards.description: Oil dripping from the bellhousing area, smoke from the engine bay or falling oil levels may come from the rear crankshaft seal or gaskets. We trace the leak and inspect the seals.

cards.title: Fuel and Mixture Problems
cards.description: Hesitation, rough idle, poor economy or hard starting can relate to carburettor, fuel injection or vacuum leak problems, depending on the engine version. We check fuelling, vacuum and mixture settings.

cards.title: Ignition and Misfire Faults
cards.description: Misfires, backfiring or poor starting are often caused by worn distributor parts, ignition leads, spark plugs or incorrect ignition timing. We test the ignition system and set the timing.

engineOverview.title: Land Rover Discovery 1 3.5 V8 Engine: The Complete Owner's Guide
paragraphs: The Land Rover Discovery 1 3.5 V8 engine is the 3.5-litre aluminium Rover V8 petrol fitted to early Discovery models. Smooth and torquey, it is now a classic engine, and timing chain wear, camshaft problems, head gasket failures and oil leaks often lead owners to repair, rebuild or replace it.

The 3.5 Rover V8 was used in many vehicles and produced in carburettor and fuel-injected forms, with different ancillaries and sumps. We identify the correct Land Rover Discovery 1 engine by checking the engine number, VIN and registration before supply.

Whether you need a targeted repair, a Land Rover engine rebuild or a complete Discovery 1 3.5 V8 engine replacement, our team inspects the vehicle and explains each option. Call us or send your registration for a written quote.
